beats.intent: ThinkSR keeps a dense carrier while a compact DQ-CTM process repeatedly updates windowed features with shared parameters.
beats.claim: ThinkSR end to end: encoder, windows, shared DQ-CTM ticks, decoder.
beats.narration: ThinkSR separates the dense image field from the compact thought process that updates it. The encoder first turns the low-resolution image into features. The window step groups that dense field without dropping the spatial carrier. DQ-CTM then runs repeated ticks over the windowed representation. The same DQ-CTM parameters are shared across those ticks. The decoder turns the updated dense field back into the super-resolved output.

params.headline: ThinkSR updates a dense carrier through shared thought ticks
params.note: Persistent dense carrier, compact thought process

beats.intent: The carrier starts as encoder features from the low-resolution image, then window partitioning produces tokens while preserving the full dense field.
beats.narration: The carrier equation defines the data that the thought process reads and updates. The encoder maps the low-resolution image into a dense feature field. The window partition then forms tokens from that field while keeping every token in the carrier.

params.headline: The dense carrier is encoded first, then partitioned into windows

terms.label: encoder turns the low-resolution image into dense features
window partition keeps every token from the feature field

beats.intent: DQ-CTM-SR is not the smallest model in the benchmark; at 1.129 million parameters, it is second largest among the five listed methods.
beats.narration: The parameter comparison puts DQ-CTM-SR closer to CARN than to the smaller lightweight baselines. CATANet is the smallest listed model at 0.535 million parameters. RFDN is slightly larger at 0.550 million. IMDN uses 0.715 million parameters. DQ-CTM-SR uses 1.129 million parameters, making it the second largest of these five. CARN is the largest at 1.592 million parameters.

params.headline: DQ-CTM-SR is the second largest model in this comparison
